basics.description: Orbit deploys to your Azure subscription as two Container Apps + Postgres + Key Vault, all in the same resource group. Total runtime cost: ~$15-25/month.

location.label: Region
location.toolTip: Pick the region closest to your users. Microsoft Container Apps + Postgres Flexible Server must be available there.

basics.name: namePrefix
basics.label: Resource name prefix
basics.toolTip: Lowercase letters and numbers only. Used as the prefix for every resource (e.g. 'orbit-backend', 'orbit-pg-xxxxxx').

constraints.validationMessage: 3–11 characters; lowercase letters and numbers only; must start with a letter.

basics.name: adminEmail
basics.label: Admin email
basics.toolTip: Email of the first admin user. Must match a user in your Microsoft Entra tenant so they can sign in.

subLabel.preValidation: Set up your Entra app registration

options.text: Orbit signs users in with Microsoft. Before continuing you need an Entra app registration. See the README for the 5-minute setup walkthrough. You'll paste three values below: Tenant ID, Application (client) ID, and a Client secret value.

elements.name: msTenantId
elements.label: Microsoft Entra tenant ID
elements.toolTip: From Entra portal → Overview → Tenant ID (a GUID).

elements.name: msClientId
elements.label: Application (client) ID
elements.toolTip: From your Entra app registration → Overview → Application (client) ID.

elements.name: msClientSecret
elements.toolTip: The VALUE column from Entra app registration → Certificates & secrets. Not the Secret ID. Stored in Azure Key Vault on deploy.

constraints.validationMessage: Paste the secret value (at least 8 characters).
